name: weak-hash-md5-sha1
attack_scenario: An attacker crafts two different inputs with the same MD5/SHA-1 digest (chosen-prefix collision) to forge a document that passes an integrity check, or cracks leaked unsalted MD5 password hashes at billions of guesses per second on commodity GPUs.
negative_test_hint: hash a password or integrity digest with algorithm "MD5 or SHA-1" and assert the test fails, requiring SHA-256 or stronger, or a salted adaptive hash for passwords

exemplar.explanation: MD5 and SHA-1 are cryptographically broken (practical collisions) and, being fast unsalted hashes, are unfit for passwords or integrity. SHA-256 or stronger resists collisions, and passwords should use a salted adaptive hash such as bcrypt or Argon2.
